answer.content: Review of the preprint's metadata and abstract reveals no mention of controlled, token-constrained memory evaluation, shared benchmarks, dynamic input-driven state changes, or baseline comparisons. The document describes general agent behavior without verifiable experimental design or measurable state evolution under defined constraints. This confirms the absence of foundational rigor in current memory evaluation protocols as previously identified in the literature review phase.
